en: Added a scrollbar to the `/skills`, `/mcp` and `/plugin` Installed lists in fullscreen mode, like the one `/workflows` now has: it appears while the mouse is over the list and can be clicked or dragged
zh: 新增全屏模式下 `/skills`、`/mcp` 和 `/plugin` 已安装列表的滚动条，与 `/workflows` 现在的滚动条类似：鼠标悬停在列表上时出现，可点击或拖动
